_notes.title: The name on the surface screen and in the corner of every photo.
_notes.diverName: Stamped on every photo as "Photo by …" and shown on the surface screen.
_notes.theme: The water: abyss (blue-black, cyan glow), kelp (green water, gold glow), or volcanic (red vents, orange glow). Each has a light and a dark look that follows the device.
_notes.seed: Any word. The trench's bends, its rock, and where the vents stand all come from it; the same word makes the same trench.
_notes.airSeconds: Seconds of air for one dive, including the climb back up. 120 is the standard dive; 45 to 600.
_notes.species: Which creatures live in the trench: any of whale, manta, school, jellyfish, lanternfish, anglerfish, squid, crab. Leave out a name to leave it out of the dive and the log.
